      "id": 349837574,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-349837574",
      "created_at": "2017-12-07T01:59:03Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "Found some interesting info on Piwik's website:  \r\n\r\nhttps://piwik.pro/gdpr-compliance/  \r\n\r\nAlso, bundling Tor with the application is an \"easy\" way to anonymize metadata \"out of the box\". This is what apps like Ricochet and OnionShare do to anonymize user metadata (including - especially - user IP addresses).  "
    },
    {
      "id": 424375042,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-424375042",
      "created_at": "2018-09-25T14:49:29Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "As a stop gap to fully anonymous and untraceable metrics, we could also have a dialog asking a user if they'd like to provide metrics to us.\r\n\r\nWe've talked about adding [`Sentry`](https://sentry.io/welcome/) in before, and another option that includes web3 snooping (though this sounds quite scary) is [`moesif`](https://www.moesif.com/docs/client-integration/browser-js/)."
    },
    {
      "id": 500456393,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-500456393",
      "created_at": "2019-06-10T15:20:05Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "This one is important. @lkngtn can you provide 2-3 important metrics that would help us understand how people use the client? With that, I can do some initial research on solutions"
    },
    {
      "id": 503572012,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-503572012",
      "created_at": "2019-06-19T13:56:45Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "So we mainly need:\r\n- A way to contact our most active users (they can provide an email via HelpScout, notifications or an opt-in modal)\r\n- A way to know the referrers (where our users come from)\r\n\r\nMatomo can totally work for this."
    },
    {
      "id": 503623408,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-503623408",
      "created_at": "2019-06-19T16:00:30Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 6",
      "body": "Would also add:\r\n- geographic/region data will also be useful for prioritizing localization and other efforts which might be tied to traction in specific regions. \r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 508063410,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-508063410",
      "created_at": "2019-07-03T12:00:13Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "I'd add that it'd be useful to know which orgs are being visited, and when, which is easily provided via the URL path."
    },
    {
      "id": 600854713,
      "url": "https://github.com/aragon/client/issues/11#issuecomment-600854713",
      "created_at": "2020-03-18T20:57:36Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "Closing; we may work on adding analytics in the future but its current effort is deprioritized."
    }
  ],
